svg.text: T(n,h) computation regimes, theoretical to n=50
fixed polyplets; cell = one T(n,h); n = cells, h = bounding-box height (h≤n). Diagonals pinned through k≤7 (a23).
low strip h≤2 + pinned diagonals k≤7 (a23)
The two GREEN edges (low strip + diagonal
wedge) eat in from the sides; the RED slab
h=3..2n/3 is the irreducible exponential core.
The AMBER band widens with n: each deeper run
MUST keep pinning new diagonals or the swept
At n=50: peak swept h≈33 (μ^33). Without
bootstrapping past k=7, it would be h≈42.
